name: Tokudoku Series - Toubousha Dokujima Nero ~Sunadokei no Maid Hen~
original_name: 得々シリーズ　逃亡者　毒島音露～砂時計のメイド編～
source:
This is the last product of "Dokujima" series. This item includes five short stories. Dictionary system is included in this item, too.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305061251/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1003215]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
本作是《毒岛音露》系列最后一部作品，收录5篇短篇故事，并同样配备词典系统。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305061251/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1003215]Eroge Shop[/url]]
